rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose rendering for being careless or failing to pay attention.

example.english: You were negligent in your work and left several pages out of the report.
example.traditional: 你做嘢粗心大意，份報告漏咗幾頁。
example.jyutping: nei5 zou6 je5 cou1 sam1 daai6 ji3 fan6 bou3 gou3 lau6 zo2 gei2 jip6

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice when stressing that someone is careless or not careful enough.

example.english: I was negligent for a moment and broke the cup.
example.traditional: 我一時唔小心，整爛咗個杯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 si4 m4 siu2 sam1 zing2 laan6 zo2 go3 bui1

rows.note: Use this specifically when the negligence comes from being inattentive or not concentrating.

example.english: You were negligent in class because you were not concentrating, so you missed the teacher’s explanation.
example.traditional: 你上堂唔專心，所以漏聽咗老師嘅解釋。
example.jyutping: nei5 soeng5 tong4 m4 zyun1 sam1 so2 ji5 lau6 teng1 zo2 lou5 si1 ge3 gaai2 sik1
